questions.q: If the radius of a circle is decreased by $35\%$ then its area decreases by?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, jab bhi area me change pucha ho aur radius ghate, toh bina pen uthaye samajh ja ki do baar successive lagna hai kyunki area $\pi r^2$ hota hai. Direct decimal fraction ka khela hai yahan. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Direct AB Rule pel de: $x + y + \frac{xy}{100}$. Yahan decrease hai, toh dono negative lenge: $-35 - 35 + \frac{-35 \times -35}{100} = -70 + 12.25 = -57.75\%$. Ab $57.75\%$ ko fraction me dekhega toh $.75$ ka matlab $\frac{3}{4}$ hota hai, yani $57 \frac{3}{4}\%$. Method 2 (Concept Builder): Fraction me khel le. $35\% = \frac{7}{20}$. Yani radius 20 se 13 ho gaya. Area iska square hoga, yani $20^2$ se $13^2$ banega (400 se 169). Decrease hua 231 ka. Percentage net decrease $= \frac{231}{400} \times 100 = 57.75\%$. Exam Takeaway: Examiner aksar decimal answer aane pe options ko fraction me de kar darata hai. .75 = 3/4 yaad rakh!
FormulaUsage
$x + y + \frac{xy}{100}$For any 2D Area Successive Change

questions.q: If decreasing 80 by $x\%$ gives the same result as increasing 16 by $x\%$, then $x\%$ of 120 is how much percentage more than $33.33\%$ of 210?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, question lamba zaroor hai par basic equation ka hai. 80 aur 16 ke beech 5:1 ka ratio dikhte hi dimaag me fraction aana chahiye. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Equation set kar: $80(1 - \frac{x}{100}) = 16(1 + \frac{x}{100})$. 16 se 80 ko 5 baar kaat. $5 - \frac{5x}{100} = 1 + \frac{x}{100} \implies 4 = \frac{6x}{100} \implies x = 66.66\%$. Ab sawal ka part 2 padh: $66.66\%$ (yani $\frac{2}{3}$) of 120 = 80. Aur dusra part $33.33\%$ (yani $\frac{1}{3}$) of 210 = 70. Pucha hai 80, 70 se kitna zyada hai? 10 zyada hai base 70 pe. $\frac{10}{70} = \frac{1}{7} = 14.28\%$. Bawal! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Agar $x$ nikalne me time lag raha hai, toh options aur standard fractions $1/7, 1/8$ yaad hone chahiye. $\frac{1}{7}$ direct $14.28\%$ hit karega. Exam Takeaway: Aise sawal double-step hote hain, calculation fast rakhni padegi. Percentages ko sidha fraction me convert kar.
FractionPercentage
1/7$14.28\%$

questions.q: The income of A is 5080 per month. he saves $40\%$ of his income. If his monthly income increases by $20\%$ and expenditure increases by $30\%$ then his monthly savings increase by?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, 5080 ki shuruat me koi zaroorat nahi hai! Ye examiner ka trap hai calculations me uljhane ke liye. Seedha Income = Exp + Sav ratio pe khelna hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Savings $40\%$ hai, toh Exp $60\%$ hoga. Ratio Exp : Sav = 3 : 2. Total Income 5 unit ho gayi. JSM Equation laga: $5 \times 20\% = 3 \times 30\% + 2 \times x\% \implies 100 = 90 + 2x \implies x = 5\%$. Yani savings sirf $5\%$ badhi hai. Original saving kitni thi? 5080 ka $40\% = 2032$. Nayi saving us se 5% zyada hai. $2032$ ka $5\%$ nikal (yani $\frac{1}{20}$). $2032 / 20 = 101.6$. Answer done! Method 2 (Concept Builder): 100 maan ke kar le. Income 100, Exp 60, Sav 40. Nayi Income 120, Naya Exp $60 \times 1.3 = 78$. Nayi Sav = $120 - 78 = 42$. Pehle Sav 40 thi, ab 42 ho gayi. Percentage increase $5\%$. Phir value nikal le. Exam Takeaway: Jab bhi ratio pe percentage badhe, hamesha real values ko ignore karke end me apply kar.
ComponentUnitsChange
Expenditure3$30\%$
Savings2$5\%$ (Derived)

questions.q: Last year in CAT, each section of the question paper had different weightage. The weightage of QA, DI and VA/RC sections were 8, 9 and 10 respectively. The maximum marks in all the three sections together was 810. Wrong answer did not carry negative marks as a penalty. If Padma had gotten $20\%$ more marks in QA and $8\%$ more marks in DI and $7.14\dots\%$ more marks in VA/RC, then she must had gotten $100\%$ marks in all the three sections. The total marks that Padma had scored:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, bhasha bhayankar hai par logic lallu hai. Ratio 8:9:10 ka sum 27 hota hai, jo 810 ke barabar diya hai. Pura khel wapas back-track karne ka hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): $27 \text{ units} = 810 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = 30$. Max marks nikal gaye: QA=240, DI=270, VA=300. Ab ulta chalo, question keh raha hai ki itne percentage zyada aate toh 100% (max) aate. Toh purane marks the: QA = $\frac{240}{1.2} = 200$. DI = $\frac{270}{1.08} = 250$. VA me $7.14\%$ (yani $\frac{1}{14}$) zyada aate. Matlab $\frac{15}{14}$ score hota max marks. Toh asli score $\frac{14}{15} \times 300 = 280$ raha hoga. Total marks = $200 + 250 + 280 = 730$. Method 2 (Concept Builder): Agar percentage fraction conversion me dikkat hai: $20\%$ zyada matlab 120% = 240, toh 100% = 200. Wahi basic logic fraction se fast hota hai. Exam Takeaway: Lamba paragraph dekh kar darna mana hai. Reverse engineering se question 20 second me toot'ta hai.
SectionMax MarksMultiplier
QA240$\frac{1}{1.2}$
VA300$\frac{14}{15}$

questions.q: In a cricket series, Team A had a winning rate of $70\%$ after playing x matches. Then they lost 20 matches consecutively, and their winning rate fell to $50\%$. Find the total matches played by Team A before the losing streak?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM / Mixture Alligation Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, jab do alag alag chizon ka average/rate mix hokar ek naya overall rate bane, wahan hamesha Alligation lagta hai. Rate $70\%$ tha, haar me rate $0\%$ hai, aur mix hoke $50\%$ bana. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Alligation ratio nikal. Part 1: $70\%$, Part 2 (Losses): $0\%$. Overall: $50\%$. Cross subtract mar: $(50-0) : (70-50) = 50 : 20 = 5 : 2$. Yani (Initial Matches) : (Losing Streak Matches) ka ratio $5:2$ hona chahiye. Hame baad ke match pata hain = 20 (yani 2 unit = 20). Toh 5 unit = 50. Khel khatam! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic equation se jayega toh: $\frac{0.7x + 0}{x + 20} = 0.5$. Isko solve karega toh $0.7x = 0.5x + 10 \implies 0.2x = 10 \implies x = 50$. Time consuming hai par concept wahi hai. Exam Takeaway: Winning rate ya pass/fail average me jab constant naya judta hai toh Mixture concept hit kiya kar.
StateWin RateRatio
Initial$70\%$5 units (50 matches)
Losing Streak$0\%$2 units (20 matches)

questions.q: In measuring the sides of a rectangle, errors of $10\%$ and $8\%$ in excess are made. Find the error percent in its area.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, area $L \times B$ hota hai. Jab bhi product wali entity me dono components percentage se badhein, toh direct Successive ka formula chalega bina zyada soche. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Seedha AB rule thok de: $a + b + \frac{a \times b}{100}$. Dono error 'excess' me hain yani positive change. $+10$ aur $+8$. Net Area Error $= 10 + 8 + \frac{10 \times 8}{100} = 18 + 0.8 = 18.8\%$. Option C seedha mark kar de. Method 2 (Concept Builder): Man le sides $100$ aur $100$ the. Area $10000$. Ab sides $110$ aur $108$ ho gaye. Naya area $110 \times 108 = 11880$. Change kitna hua? 1880 ka 10000 pe. Yani $18.8\%$. Exam Takeaway: Pen tabhi chala jab dimag rule set kar chuka ho. Simple additions ko mind me karo.
RuleCalculation
$A + B + \frac{AB}{100}$$10 + 8 + 0.8 = 18.8\%$

questions.q: Every month, a man consumes 15 kg of rice and 6 kg of wheat. The price of rice is $20\%$ of the price of wheat, resulting in a total expenditure of 225 per month for rice and wheat combined. If the price of wheat is increased by $12\%$, what percentage reduction in rice consumption is needed to maintain the same expenditure of 225? (Given that price of rice and consumption of wheat is constant)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: CPR (Constant Product Ratio) / Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, price of Rice $20\%$ of Wheat hai, yani inka price ratio 1:5 hoga. Kharcha maintain karna hai toh idhar ka paisa udhar compensate karna padega. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): R:W price ratio 1:5 hai. Maan le Rice Rs. $x$/kg, Wheat Rs. $5x$/kg. Total bill: $15(x) + 6(5x) = 45x$. Par total kharcha 225 diya hai $\implies 45x = 225 \implies x = 5$. Toh Rice = Rs. 5/kg, Wheat = Rs. 25/kg. Ab Wheat price 12% bada, yani $25 \times 0.12 = 3$ Rs badha per kg. 6 kg wheat pe Rs. 18 ka extra phatka. Total bill 225 hi rakhna hai toh ye 18 Rs Rice kam khakar bachana hoga. 1 kg Rice 5 ka hai. Kitna Rice kam aayega? $\frac{18}{5} = 3.6$ kg. Pehle rice khata tha 15 kg. Percentage reduction = $\frac{3.6}{15} \times 100 = 24\%$. Method 2 (Concept Builder): Ek ek value ko fraction me handle kar, par equations lamba padenge. Focus on 'extra cost' compensation. Exam Takeaway: Expense maintaining wale sawalo me pura recalculate mat kar. Sirf "Extra Badha Hua Kharcha = Doosri taraf bachi hui unit" pe equate kar.
ItemPriceQty
Rice515 kg
Wheat256 kg

questions.q: If $7\%$ of a number is 21, what is the value of the number minus $25\%$ of itself? (PHASE XIII(GRAD) - $\frac{30}{07}$/2025 - SHIFT 3)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Percentage to Percentage seedha relation bana. Number nikalne me time kyu waste karna! Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Agar $7\% = 21$ hai, toh obviously $1\% = 3$ hoga. Pucha kya hai? Number me se usika $25\%$ hata do. Yani hume number ka $75\%$ chahiye. Direct value nikal: $75 \times 3 = 225$. Khallas! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Murkho ki tarah pehle total number nikal: $100\% = 300$. Phir $300$ ka $25\%$ nikal $= 75$. Fir minus kar $300 - 75 = 225$. 10 second faltu kharch honge isme. Exam Takeaway: Intermediate steps (Total $100\%$ nikalna) bypass karke seedha target percentage pe attack kiya karo.
StatePercentageValue
Given$7\%$21
Target$75\%$225

questions.q: The prime cost of an article is thrice of raw material. If the cost of raw material is increased in the ratio 5:12 and cost of manufacturing expenses is increased in the ratio 4:5. If the initial cost is 6 then find the final cost?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, total Prime Cost do chizon se banti hai: Raw Material aur Manufacturing. Hamein relation break karna aana chahiye bina equations likhe. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Initial prime cost 6 di hai, jo Raw (RM) ka 3 guna hai. Yani RM = 2 hoga. Toh bachi hui cost Manufacturing (Mfg) hogi = 4 (Kyunki $2+4=6$). Ab scale laga! RM 5:12 me badha, yani agar RM pehle 5 tha toh 12 hua. Yahan hamara RM 2 hai, toh kitna hoga? $\frac{12}{5} \times 2 = 4.8$. Mfg 4:5 me badha. Hamara Mfg 4 hi hai, toh badh kar seedha 5 ho jayega. Nayi Final Cost = Naya RM + Naya Mfg = $4.8 + 5 = 9.8$. Seedha aur sateek! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Cost equations variables me maan le $3x, x, 2x$ aur fir fractions me ghoomta reh. Answer phir bhi $9.8$ hi aayega. Exam Takeaway: Ratio shifting ko directly split values par laga diya kar.
ComponentInitialFinal (Scaled)
Raw Material24.8
Manufacturing45

questions.q: Income of a person increases by $x\%$ and $x/2\%$ during first and third year but decreases by $x\%$ and $x/2\%$ 2nd year and 4th year respectively if the total decrement during four year is $\text{Rs. } 3340.8$. then find the initial income of person if during first two-year, total salary decreases by $36\%$
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, thoda heavy question hai, tukdo me padh! Ek baar plus, ek baar same percent minus ho, toh result humesha net decrease hota hai $\frac{x^2}{100}\%$. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Pehle do saal: $+x\%$ aur $-x\%$. Net change = $- \frac{x^2}{100}\%$. Ye value $36\%$ decrease ke barabar di hai. Toh $\frac{x^2}{100} = 36 \implies x = 60$. Teesra aur chautha saal padh: $x/2 = 30\%$ se badha aur fir $30\%$ ghata. Iska net decrease hoga $- \frac{30^2}{100} = -9\%$. Charo saal ka overall successive nikal: Pehle cycle me value $0.64$ times bachi (36% gayi), dusre me $0.91$ times (9% gayi). Overall bachi $= 0.64 \times 0.91 = 0.5824$. Decrease kitna hua? $1 - 0.5824 = 0.4176$ (yani $41.76\%$). $41.76\%$ of Initial Salary = $3340.8$. Solve karega toh Base = $3340.8 / 0.4176 = 8000$ aayega. Method 2 (Concept Builder): Fraction se ratio banayega tab bhi aayega par 0.64 aur 0.91 ke decimals zyada clean approach dete hain yahan. Exam Takeaway: Symmetrical successive changes ($+x\%, -x\%$) humesha negative impact daalte hain. Is property pe direct hit kar.
PhasePercentagesNet Multiplier
Years 1-2$+60\%, -60\%$$0.64$ ($-36\%$)
Years 3-4$+30\%, -30\%$$0.91$ ($-9\%$)

questions.q: Two numbers are respectively $20\%$ less and $30\%$ more than a third number. What is the ratio of the two numbers? (CHSL TIER I- $\frac{12}{11}$/2025-SHIFT 2)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, ye free ke number hain pre exam ke! Jab bhi do chizein kisi teesre se compare ho, 3rd entity ko humesha 100 maan liya kar. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Third number ko aakhe band kar ke 100 maan le. Pehla number 20% kam hai, yani 80 ho gaya. Dusra number 30% zyada hai, yani 130 ho gaya. Dono ka direct ratio maang liya: 80 : 130. Zero se zero uda, 8 : 13 answer aapki screen par! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variables maan ke karega $x$, $0.8x$, $1.3x$ toh bhi answer same aayega bas tera competition aage nikal jayega. Exam Takeaway: Aise questions ko 10-15 seconds me nipta ke difficult questions ke liye time bachana hota hai.

questions.q: 10,000 voters vote to elect their mayor. A receives 500 votes more than that of B and wins the election. $5\%$ of the votes are invalid. If a news TV channel predicts that after 5 years the number of voters will increase by $50\%$ and A will receive $10\%$ votes less than that he received now, how many votes will B get at that time? (Assume all the votes as valid after 5 years and only A and B stand in the election in both the time)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling / JSM Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, linear calculations hain. Total vote aur winning margin diya ho toh dono candidates ke vote verbally add/subtract karke nikalne aane chahiye. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Pehle present data nikal. 10,000 ka $5\%$ (500) invalid ho gaye. Valid bache $9500$. Ab A aur B me equation banegi: $A + B = 9500$ aur margin $A - B = 500$. Dono equations ko add karega toh $2A = 10000 \implies A = 5000$. Matlab B ko abhi $4500$ mile hain. TV prediction pe aa: 5 saal baad total voters $50\%$ badh jayenge (sab valid) = $15000$. A ko pichle bar se $10\%$ kam vote milenge, yani $5000$ ka $90\% = 4500$. B ke vote nikalne ke liye bache hue vote pakad: $15000 - 4500 = 10500$ vote! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Ek ek ko variables me assume karega toh confuse ho jayega. Values round hain toh sidha data pe khel. Exam Takeaway: Sum and Difference equations ($x+y=A, x-y=B$) ko mentally solve karna seekho.
TimelineTotal ValidCandidate ACandidate B
Present950050004500
Future (5 Yrs)15000450010500

questions.q: A fraction in reduced form is such that when it is squared and then its numerator is increased by $25\%$ and the denominator is reduced to $80\%$ it results in $\frac{5}{8}$ of the original fraction. The product of the numerator and denominator is:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, fraction par percentage operations sidha unke multipliers se likhe jaane chahiye. Increase $25\%$ means $5/4$, and reduced to $80\%$ means $4/5$. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Maan le original fraction $\frac{N}{D}$ hai. Isko square kiya toh bana $\frac{N^2}{D^2}$. Numerator ko $25\%$ badhaya yani $\frac{5}{4}$ kiya. Denominator ko $80\%$ kar diya yani $\frac{4}{5}$ kiya. Naya fraction bana: $\frac{(\frac{5}{4}) N^2}{(\frac{4}{5}) D^2} = \frac{25}{16} \frac{N^2}{D^2}$. Question kehta hai ki ye value original fraction ka $\frac{5}{8}$ hai. Toh equate kar de: $\frac{25}{16} \frac{N^2}{D^2} = \frac{5}{8} \frac{N}{D}$. Ek $\frac{N}{D}$ cancel ho gaya. Bacha $\frac{N}{D} = \frac{5}{8} \times \frac{16}{25} = \frac{2}{5}$. Toh apna original fraction $\frac{2}{5}$ tha. Numerator $\times$ Denominator = $2 \times 5 = 10$. Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variables le kar lamba karega toh equation ulajh jayegi. Cancel out as soon as possible. Exam Takeaway: "Reduced TO" aur "Reduced BY" ka language dhyan se padha kar. Yahan reduced TO $80\%$ tha, yani direct $4/5$ lagana hai.
OperationMultiplier
Numerator $+25\%$$5/4$
Denominator to $80\%$$4/5$

questions.q: The number of students in A is (y + 63) which is 47 less than that of B. If the number of boys in B is $\frac{1}{3}$ of the total number of students in B and the number of girls in B is $75\%$ of the total number of students in A, then find the total number of students in B?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling / Cross-Product Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, yahan 'y' wali line ekdum bekaar hai, bas time khane ko di hai. Focus sirf A aur B ke relation aur fractions par rakh. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Pehli line ka saar hai $A = B - 47$. Ab equation banate hain: B me boys $1/3$ hain, toh seedhi baat hai girls $2/3$ hongi. B ki girls $75\%$ (yani $3/4$) of A ke barabar hain. Equation bani: $\frac{2}{3}B = \frac{3}{4}A$. Hamein pata hai $A = B - 47$. Substitute kar de: $\frac{2}{3}B = \frac{3}{4}(B - 47)$. Cross multiply mar de: $8B = 9B - 9 \times 47$. Toh sidha $B = 423$ aayega. Aur yahi pucha hai. Khatam! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Agar fractions uljhane wale lagein toh ratio likh lo. $B_{girls} : B_{total} = 2 : 3$. And $B_{girls} : A_{total} = 3 : 4$. Dono me $B_{girls}$ ko equate karke ratios mila lo. 2 aur 3 ka LCM 6 banao. Toh $B = 9$, $A = 8$. Difference 1 unit = 47. B chahiye toh $9 \times 47 = 423$. Exam Takeaway: Variables dekh kar confuse mat ho. Unhe ratio me ghuma do.
EntityRatio Form
Total B9 units
Total A8 units

questions.q: Bag A contains x balls and the number of balls in Bag B is $20\%$ more than that of Bag A and the number of balls in Bag C is (x + 15)% more than that of Bag B. If the total number of balls in Bag B and C is 27, find the value of (x*3+10).
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, logically soch isko, ye common sense se hi fut jayega. Balls hamesha integer (pure number) hoti hain, adhuri ball toh exist nahi karegi. B, A se $20\%$ (1/5) zyada hai, yani A kam se kam 5 ka multiple hona chahiye. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Hit and trial kar, integer rule lagake. Agar hum $x=10$ (jo ki 5 ka multiple hai) mante hain, toh A = 10, toh B = 12 ho jayega (20% more). Ab C ka dekhte hain: C jo hai wo B se $(10+15)\%$ yani $25\%$ (1/4) zyada hoga. B = 12 ka $25\%$ hota hai 3, toh C = 15. Total B aur C ki sankhya $12+15 = 27$ ho gayi. Condition perfectly match ho gayi! Matlam x = 10 bilkul sahi tha. Pucha hai: $x \times 3 + 10 = 10 \times 3 + 10 = 40$. Bawal approach! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Equations likhke quadratic solve karega: $B = 1.2x$, $C = 1.2x \times (1 + (x+15)/100)$. Dono ka sum = 27. Itna math exam me nahi karna bhai. Exam Takeaway: Objects ya insaano ko humesha absolute integer hona padta hai, yahi property best shortcut hoti hai.
BagValue Based on x=10
A10
B12
C15

questions.q: If a student multiplied a number by $\frac{6}{11}$ instead of $\frac{5}{6}$ find the % error in the calculation?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Jab bhi fractions aapas me takraye, fractions ke denominators ka LCM number maan liya kar taaki decimal ka kachra na ho. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): 11 aur 6 ka LCM 66 hota hai. Maan le original number 66 hai. Sahi result aana tha: $66 \times \frac{5}{6} = 55$. Galati se result kya aaya: $66 \times \frac{6}{11} = 36$. Error kitne ka hua? $55 - 36 = 19$. Error humesha asli value (55) pe niklega. % Error = $\frac{19}{55} \times 100$. Ab isko thoda estimate kar: $55$ ka $10\% = 5.5$, toh $30\% = 16.5$. Us se upar hai, toh approx $34.5\%$ ke aspaas aayega. Exact fraction hoga $34 \frac{6}{11}\%$. Options dekhte hi idea lag jayega. Method 2 (Concept Builder): Cross multiply bhi use kar sakta hai. True value : Error value $= \frac{5}{6} : \frac{6}{11}$. Cross mar: $55 : 36$. Error 19 ka on 55. Wahi baat hai, bas representation alag. Exam Takeaway: Fractions ko integer me convert karne ki aadat bana, calculation 10 guna tez hogi.
CalculationOutput
Correct (on 66)55
Incorrect (on 66)36

questions.q: A fruit seller sells $45\%$ of the oranges that he has along with one more orange to a customer. He then sells $20\%$ of the remaining oranges and 2 more oranges to a second customer. He then sells $90\%$ of the now remaining oranges to a third customer and is still left with 5 oranges. How many oranges did the fruit seller have initially?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, jab bhi successive remainder wala sawal ho aur numbers me kuch extra joda/ghataya jaye, wahan aage se equations banana suicide hai. Hamesha Reverse Line Method (Peeche se aage ki taraf) use kar. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): C3 (Customer 3) ko $90\%$ becha aur fir bhi 5 bache hain. Yani jo $10\%$ bacha uski value 5 hai. Toh C3 ke aane se theek pehle total $50$ oranges the. C2 ke time: usne $20\%$ beche aur 2 extra diye. Agar wo 2 extra nahi diye hote, toh uske paas $50+2=52$ hote. Ye 52, us stage ka $80\%$ bacha hua hissa tha. Toh C2 ke aane se pehle total = $\frac{52}{0.8} = 65$ the. C1 ke time: usne $45\%$ beche aur 1 extra diya. Agar 1 extra nahi diya hota, toh $65+1=66$ bachte, jo initial ka $55\%$ hote (kyunki $45\%$ bik gaya tha). Toh Initial Total = $\frac{66}{0.55} = 120$. Piche se socho, mind me ho jayega. Method 2 (Concept Builder): Options se uthakar forward track kar sakte ho agar reverse samajh nahi aa raha, jaise 120 ka 45% + 1 nikalna, fir jo bache uspe game khelna. Exam Takeaway: Remaining items aur constant adjustments wale sawal hamesha reverse engineering mangte hain.
Customer StageCalculation (Reverse)Oranges Before
Customer 3$5 / 0.10$50
Customer 2$(50+2) / 0.80$65
Customer 1 (Initial)$(65+1) / 0.55$120

questions.q: A number is divided into two parts in such a way that $75\%$ of the first part is 6 more than $90\%$ of the second part and $80\%$ of the second part is 12 more than $45\%$ of the first part. Then the number is?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, equations banane padenge par unko decimals aur percentages ki bimari se mukt karna padega. Percentages ko direct equations me daal kar simple linear form bana. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Parts ko P aur Q maan le. Eq1: $0.75P - 0.9Q = 6$. Eq2: $0.8Q - 0.45P = 12$. Inhe clean kar 100 se multiply karke aur common divide maarke. Eq1: $75P - 90Q = 600$ (divide by 15 $\implies 5P - 6Q = 40$). Eq2: $80Q - 45P = 1200$ (divide by 5 $\implies 16Q - 9P = 240$). Ab pehli eq ko 9 se aur dusri ko 5 se multiply karke add kar de taaki P udd jaye! $-54Q + 80Q = 360 + 1200 \implies 26Q = 1560 \implies Q = 60$. Q ki value P wali choti equation me daal de, $5P - 360 = 40 \implies 5P = 400 \implies P = 80$. Total Number $= 80 + 60 = 140$. Mazboot algebra ki zarurat thi yahan. Method 2 (Concept Builder): Options se check karne ki galti mat karna kyunki options me total sum diya hai, individual P aur Q nahi. Simultaneous equations hi best hain. Exam Takeaway: Decimal equations ko sabse chhoti integer value me convert kiye bina substitution kabhi mat karna.

questions.q: Varun gave $60\%$ of the money he had to his wife. He also gave $20\%$ of the remaining amount to each of his three children. Three-fifth of the amount now left was spent on miscellaneous items, and the remaining amount of $\text{Rs. } 9,600$ was deposited in the bank. How much money did Varun have initially?:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, tree method ya successive line dono se chalega! Par language me bacha kar chalna hai: '20% to each of his three children' bole toh $20 \times 3 = 60\%$ of remaining kharch hua hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Initial amount ko 100 maan le. 60 wife ko de diya, bacha 40. Ab is 40 ka $60\%$ (20% x 3 bachhe) usne de diya. $40$ ka $60\% = 24$. Ab bacha $40 - 24 = 16$. Is 16 me se 'Three-fifth' (yani $\frac{3}{5}$) usne miscellaneous me uda diya. Toh bacha kitna? $\frac{2}{5}$ hissa. $16$ ka $\frac{2}{5} = 6.4$ unit bacha. Question ke hisab se $6.4$ unit = 9600. Pucha total (100 unit) hai. $\frac{9600}{6.4} \times 100 = 1500 \times 100 = 1,50,000$. Done! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Straight chain fraction bana le: $x \times (1 - 0.6) \times (1 - 0.6) \times (1 - 3/5) = 9600$. Yani $x \times 0.4 \times 0.4 \times 0.4 = 9600$. $x \times 0.064 = 9600 \implies x = 1,50,000$. Exam Takeaway: Examiner 'each' word daal kar hamesha trap karta hai, usay nazarandaaz mat karna.

After Wife ($60\%$)40
After Children ($60\%$)16
After Misc ($3/5$)6.4 units

questions.q: After two successive increments, a person's salary became $156.25\%$ of the original salary. If the percentage increase in the second increment was equal to that in the first increment, then what was the percentage of each increment?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, successive me jab barabar increment ho 2 baar toh seedha Compound Interest wala Square Root ($\sqrt{}$) concept lagta hai! Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Salary initial $100\%$ thi ab $156.25\%$ ho gayi. Ratio nikal fraction me: $\frac{156.25}{100} = 1.5625$. Kyunki 2 saal ka identical successive hai, iska square root nikal de! $\sqrt{1.5625} = 1.25$. Yani har saal ka base multiplier $1.25$ tha. Base $1$ pe $0.25$ ki badhotri ka sidha matalab hai ki $25\%$ ka increment tha har stage pe. Ekdum pen free approach! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Formula se lagayega: $(1 + \frac{r}{100})^2 = 1.5625$. Fir square root karega toh wahi $1 + \frac{r}{100} = 1.25$ aayega aur $r = 25\%$ aayega. Exam Takeaway: Identical successive percentage hamesha powers me deal hota hai. 2 baar toh square root, 3 baar toh cube root.
